Priya Patel (CSM): Heads-up — AuroraTech's prod account jumped ~2.8x token consumption week-over-week. QBR is Thursday; we need a concise cost narrative and a short remediation plan. Can ops + finops pull top usage drivers? :eyes:
Miguel Ramos (FinOps): Thanks Priya. Can you share timeframe & whether this is steady or bursty? I can run a 30/90-day smoothing and produce a burn projection for the QBR slide.
Priya Patel (CSM): Spike started last Tue afternoon, mostly sustained through Fri night. Suspiciously aligned with a new webhook release they deployed on Tue.
Jordan Kim (Onboarding): Did we change any onboarding flows or default prompts for dev/test accounts recently for AuroraTech?
Asha Rao (Customer Success): Not on onboarding side — they did a self-serve rollout of a new agent template last week per the enablement notes. I'll ping the customer for examples.
Sam Lee (Solutions): To help triage, can eng provide per-route & model breakdown and top prompt hashes? Quick query that helps me reproduce: 
```
SELECT model, route, SUM(tokens) AS tokens, COUNT(*) AS calls
FROM usage.events
WHERE customer_id = 'auroratech' AND ts >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY model, route
ORDER BY tokens DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
eng-usage-bot: Usage anomaly detected for customer_id=auroratech — +180% tokens vs baseline starting 2024-03-19T15:12:00Z. AlertId: ua-77b3.
Miguel Ramos (FinOps): Great — once we have the per-route tokens I can produce three scenarios for the QBR: baseline, current-runrate, and mitigated (if we apply throttles/caching). Approx ETA 2 hours if data pipeline returns.
Priya Patel (CSM): Urgent asks for the QBR slide: 1) top 3 cost drivers (route+model), 2) suggested immediate mitigations we can present (e.g., rate limits, prefix caching, light-quantize plan), 3) ask to customer (opt-in to agent-level sampling/ratelimts).
Sam Lee (Solutions): Suggestion for mitigations to propose: temporary rate cap on the webhook route, enable KV prefix cache for the agent, and offer a 30-min enablement session to tighten prompts.
Jordan Kim (Onboarding): I can run a 30-min workshop with AuroraTech this Wed to walk prompt best-practices. If we transcript the session, we can also add sample trimmed prompts to their onboarding doc.
Asha Rao (Customer Success): I'll coordinate the invite & ask for a handful of recent prompts. Priya — can you own the QBR narrative and slide deck updates?
Priya Patel (CSM): Yes — I'll draft the cost slide. Miguel: please send the three-scenario numbers + recommended per-month delta and quick wording for the exec ask.
Miguel Ramos (FinOps): Will do. Quick FYI — if a customer accepts a temporary throttle, we should estimate lost successful calls vs cost saved. I'll add that to the mitigated scenario.
eng-usage-bot: Query job ua-77b3-run returned: top route = /v1/generate-agent (62% tokens), top model = open-mix-16k (45% of tokens on that model).
Sam Lee (Solutions): Looks like generating long contexts on open-mix-16k is the primary culprit. Recommend proposing a short-term model fallback to 8k variant for non-critical routes.
Priya Patel (CSM): Action list for QBR prep (short):
- [ ] Miguel: three-scenario cost forecast + delta estimates (ETA 2h)
- [ ] Eng/usage: export top-100 prompt samples and route breakdown (ETA 2h)
- [ ] Asha/Jordan: schedule Wed 30-min enablement + collect examples (ETA EOD)
- [ ] Sam: prepare suggested throttling verbiage and fallback model plan (ETA 3h)
- [ ] Priya: draft slide + executive ask (ETA Wed AM)
Miguel Ramos (FinOps): I'll drop the numbers into a one-slide snapshot and include a suggested credits ask if they want to smooth billing.
Asha Rao (Customer Success): Noted. I'll also surface churn-risk flag if they don't accept mitigations (for renewals team).
Priya Patel (CSM): Thanks all — please react with :thumbsup: when you've picked up your action. I'll compile everything into the QBR deck and share a draft by Wed morning.
Sam Lee (Solutions): +1, grabbing the prompt samples now.
Jordan Kim (Onboarding): RSVP'd for the Wed session.
eng-usage-bot: Auto-note: ticket created CS-9821 for AuroraTech cost triage.
